title: TripPilot — AI Travel Research Agent
description: Describe your trip naturally. TripPilot interprets your requirements, researches travel options, applies your constraints, and returns explainable recommendations.

request.title: Describe your trip
request.description: Include your origin, destination, travel dates, travellers, budget, and any important preferences or constraints.
request.default: I am travelling from Lagos to London from October 15 to October 20, 2026 with my wife, an elderly parent and an infant. We want something reasonably priced, minimal stops and a hotel in London.
